Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list and great to meet on the call. I'm Marissa from our security/sales team; happy to own this. See answers and attachments below.

SOC 2: Redwood completed our most recent SOC 2 Type II audit in May 2026. We can share the SOC 2 Type II attestation (attached) and are happy to provide more context under an NDA if needed.

GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood supports customer-configurable data residency in our EU and US regions. We offer a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for customers storing PHI; for FinHealth we can scope that as part of Private deployment or a hosted arrangement with the appropriate controls.

Vendor questionnaire: attached is our completed vendor_security_questionnaire_template.xlsx (I filled the security section). For any gaps you flag, please send them back and I'll coordinate remediation/answers. My POC for questionnaires is marissa@redwood.com.

Pen test: Redwood conducts regular internal vulnerability scanning monthly and contracts a third-party penetration test (most recently completed April 2026 by RedTeam Labs). We can share a redacted executive summary now (attached). For the full unredacted report we require a signed NDA and coordination with our pen-test partner (RedTeam Labs) — we can provide the redacted executive summary for procurement review and kick off NDA if you need the full findings.

Vulnerability management (summary):
- Critical (CVSS 9.0-10.0): response SLA — initial triage within 4 hours; remediation target 72 hours where feasible; customer notifications for any customer-impacting critical issues within 24 hours.
- High (CVSS 7.0-8.9): remediation target 5 business days for patching/mitigation or documented mitigation plan.
- Medium/Low: tracked and prioritized in our backlog with remediation depending on severity and risk.
- Scanning cadence: internal auth/infrastructure scans weekly, vulnerability scans monthly, third-party pentests quarterly (or on major releases).
- Disclosure: coordinated disclosure policy — we follow a 30-day remediation window for vulnerabilities discovered that don't pose active exploitation risk; for customer-impacting incidents we enact our incident response runbook and will notify customers per our SLA and contractual terms.

Reqs for full report delivery:
1) Signed mutual NDA (we can send via DocuSign).
2) Signed request form confirming scope and intended recipients.
3) Coordination meeting with RedTeam Labs if FinHealth wants vendor Q&A.

Contacts:
- Pen test coordination: RedTeam Labs — pen-tests@redteamlabs.com
- Redwood security POC: marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_soc2_attestation_202605.pdf, pen_test_exec_summary_redacted_202605.pdf, vendor_security_questionnaire_template.xlsx

If helpful I can schedule a short 30-min follow-up with our security engineer and RedTeam to walk through the executive summary and remediation timelines.
